description: Our customers in Port Colboune, Welland, Sherkston, and surrounding areas may have their services impacted due to vandalism to our fibre optic cables. This can include a complete loss of all services or only a loss of TV channels. Our local team is working to restore services as quickly as possible. Services will begin to restore progressively and are expected to be up and running by early evening. We appreciate your patience and understanding.
title: P1 - INC0676153
